verdict: КЭРРИ С БАЗИСОМ — УБЫТОК: -1.9%/год, t=-1.61 (планка 3). Funding положительный, но базис съедает его.
instrument: funding-carry, FULL round trip: long spot + short perp on equal notional (net delta 0, no leverage)
limitations: Funding is recorded on the day it is paid; the exact intraday price at which it is received is not modelled.
Basis is measured close-to-close; the intraday mark-to-market path of the short perp is not.
Costs are charged only on rebalance days (every 30), which understates the true cost of entering and exiting an illiquid perp.
Top-N selection is by PAST 30-day average funding through a manual past-only window; a look-ahead would inflate the result.
The EVAL half is read once, at the end, and the DEV/EVAL split is by date.
